evidence.note: נָחוֹר follows the object marker אֶת after וַיּוֹלֶד, identifying the child Serug fathered.
Terah fathers Abram, Nahor and Haran.
Abram and Nahor take wives, and Milcah is named as Nahor’s wife.

name: נָחוֹר
summary: Genesis 11:22 names Nahor as Serug’s son. Another Nahor, a son of Terah and brother of Abram, married Milcah.
